Europe Faces Extreme Heatwave, Infrastructure and Lives Affected

Europe is experiencing an intense heatwave with temperatures reaching up to 43°C, causing significant disruption and loss of life. Reports indicate melting roads and railway tracks, and over 1300 deaths have been attributed to the heat. The extreme temperatures are particularly challenging for regions unaccustomed to such heat, contrasting with India's experience with higher temperatures.
